mentions.name: Obitrain
mentions.description: A fitness training app that logs custom calisthenics strength moves (front lever, FLAC, ¾ pull-ups) that mainstream apps don't model, and aggregates data from connected devices (Polar, Garmin, Suunto, Withings, Apple Health) plus FIT files into one weekly training view. It is free to use, with AI-generated training insights being explored as a possible addition.
mentions.problem: The author's training data lives scattered across Garmin, Polar, Withings and FIT files, and mainstream fitness apps don't model custom calisthenics strength moves like front levers.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I built one that does both (and have been using for the past 4 years+): logs custom strength moves (front lever, FLAC, ¾ pull-ups), aggregates the connected devices (Polar, Garmin, Suunto, Withings, Apple Health) into one weekly view.
